projects.title: Numira — Accounting & Business Management
projects.subtitle: Numira — Accounting & Business Management
projects.problem: Designing clearer workflows for accounting and business management, making complex financial tasks easier to understand and navigate.
projects.impact:
I designed key areas of Numira, including customer and supplier management, purchasing, accounting, and settings. My work covered purchase orders, bills, payments, vouchers, fiscal-year closing, user roles, and security flows.

The focus was on organizing information-heavy screens, maintaining consistent interaction patterns, and making important financial actions clear and predictable.
projects.tags: Product Design / Accounting / User Flows / UI Components

projects.title: SOMTU — School of Management, Tribhuvan University
projects.subtitle: SOMTU — School of Management, Tribhuvan University
projects.problem: A complete responsive university website designed to make academic information, resources, and registration easier to access.
projects.impact:
I designed the SOMTU website across desktop and mobile, creating 87 screens and 81 component variants.

The project included academic programs, notices, events, research, resources, and a seven-step registration process. I also developed a comprehensive design reference to support consistency and developer handoff.
projects.tags: Web Design / Responsive UI / Design System / Registration Flow

projects.title: The Vedic Sewa — Spiritual Services Platform
projects.subtitle: The Vedic Sewa — Spiritual Services Platform
projects.problem: Designing a connected platform that simplifies spiritual service bookings and interactions between customers and gurus.
projects.impact:
I designed customer and guru experiences for puja, yatra, and consultation bookings across web and mobile.

The work included user profiles, booking management, a shop and purchase flow, refunds, livestreams, notifications, and verification processes. Special attention was given to status-based actions, clear navigation, and handling empty, pending, locked, and error states.
projects.tags: UI/UX Design / Booking Flows / Web & Mobile / Interaction Design
